scope: User-reported review of the four UTM undergraduate programmes previously marked current-cycle-not-open.

programmes.nameEnOfficial: Bachelor of Mechanical Engineering (Manufacturing) with Honours
Bachelor in Digital Marketing with Honours

sourceHierarchy.evidence: The current UTM international programme catalogue lists all four rows with the text 'Not offered for both the September and February intakes for the 2026/2027 academic session' and a Closed action.
The Apply Now page publishes the general International Undergraduate September 2026 intake window: Phase 1 from 1 April 2026 to 15 May 2026, Phase 2 from 23 June 2026 to 17 July 2026.
sourceHierarchy.decisionWeight: confirms the undergraduate application season, but does not override programme-level closed rows
supports that the four disputed programmes are not in the September 2026 offered list

sourceHierarchy.evidence: The faculty detail pages confirm programme existence, study duration, generic Apply Now links, fees links, and international entry requirement links.
sourceHierarchy.decisionWeight: confirms programme existence and field evidence, but not current-cycle opening

decision.rationale: Strict source hierarchy requires the programme-level international catalogue and current-intake programme list to govern current-cycle availability. Generic application windows and detail-page Apply Now links cannot override a programme row marked Closed/Not offered for both September and February intakes.

nextReviewTrigger: Reopen and update to ready only if UTM publishes a newer programme-level international catalogue, current-intake PDF, or authenticated SMARt programme choice list showing one or more of these four programmes as selectable/open for the target intake.
